method.method_draft: 先描述图像：识别图中气温曲线的位置和降水符号，判断该日华北某地处于寒冷、接近冰点甚至冰点以下的天气。再结合题干询问“根据图示季节”和地点“我国长城内外”，判定季节为冬季。最后把冬季长城内外的典型地理景观表述为：长城内外——千里冰封，万里雪飘。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是华北某地某日天气变化统计图，横轴为一天中的时刻，左侧纵轴为气温（℃），右侧纵轴为气压（hPa）。气温曲线整体位于0℃附近及以下，后段明显低于0℃；图中还画有云和降水符号，表示有降水天气。再推理：华北地区气温接近或低于冰点，说明图示季节为冬季。冬季我国长城内外典型景观是严寒冰雪景象，因此可表述为“长城内外——千里冰封，万里雪飘”。

raw_record.original_question:
读华北地区某地某日天气变化资料统计图，回答问题。

<image1>

根据图示季节，我国长城内外会出现怎样的地理现象？
raw_record.answer: Inside and outside the Great Wall—thousands of li are sealed in ice, ten thousand li have snow drifting
raw_record.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a statistical chart of weather changes on a certain day at a certain place in North China. The horizontal axis is the times in a day, the left vertical axis is temperature (℃), and the right vertical axis is air pressure (hPa). The temperature curve as a whole is near and below 0℃, and the later segment is clearly below 0℃; cloud and precipitation symbols are also drawn in the figure, indicating precipitation weather. Then reason: The temperature in North China is near or below the freezing point, indicating that the season shown in the figure is winter. In winter, the typical landscape inside and outside the Great Wall in China is a severe cold ice-and-snow scene, so it can be expressed as "inside and outside the Great Wall—thousands of li are sealed in ice, ten thousand li have snow drifting".
